## Summary

Built F003 as a thin shell on top of the F001/F002 fleet summary substrate. Added `dashboard/lib/project-selector-logic.js` as a pure module: it normalizes the fleet-summary envelope, builds `All Projects + registered project` options, resolves selection in URL → localStorage → default order, formats the exact `dontpanic projects add <name> <path>` and `dontpanic dashboard build --project all` commands, and renders `Scope: Global|Project|Fleet` chips. Wired it into `core.js` (load `fleet-summary.json`, resolve selection on init, render header strip into a new `#project-selector-container`, persist on change via `history.replaceState` + `localStorage`, and re-render after `refreshState()` when the fleet fingerprint changes — so an added/removed project shows up without a server restart). Updated `what-now-logic.js` to thread `selectedProject` into a Project/Fleet scope chip, and `capabilities-logic.js` to always emit a Glo
